title: Trade for what crosses the last threshold
summary: The only lasting wealth is what can cross the last threshold. Use this day for what can still remain.
takeaway: Use this day for what can still remain.
lifeApplication: Before drifting into another task, choose one act that treats life as opportunity for meeting, service, or honest return.

source.shortMeaning: The only lasting wealth is what can cross the last threshold.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next purchase, tab, or extra hour of striving, ask what in this effort could cross the final threshold with you.

evidence.coreClaim: The only lasting wealth is what can cross the last threshold.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: pause the deal and choose the profit that can follow you.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before drifting into another task, choose one act that treats life as opportunity for meeting, service, or honest return.
